governance.note: Control probe: the nyiso-39 keeper config re-solved on the corrected measured gas data, NO new mechanism. Two measured-data fidelity fixes only: (1) the Transco Z6 NY daily quotes are placed on their TRUE calendar days (fuel._transco_z6_daily_dated; the prior even-spread put the Jan-2024 $23.90 cold-snap print on the 12th instead of the 16th and smeared every peak); (2) the NYISO monthly hub levels are recomputed from the completed daily print series (scripts/fetch_nyiso_gas_narrative.py + 5 NGWU-narrative-recovered prints; the committed monthly file's Dec-2024 read $2.45 against its own daily series' $3.30 mean because the holiday-week archive gap under-sampled the month - basis +0.16 -> +1.00). Both regenerate for a forward year (a forward monthly level x a representative true-dated daily shape) and respond to changed conditions (rule #12). No offer curve, floor, or adder changed.

exceptions.metric: C3a system load-weighted mean LMP vs actual RT
exceptions.reason: SOFT criterion -> CAVEAT. Same ledgered frontier as keepers 34/39 (min-gen ST floor adds inframarginal supply; no binding reserve scarcity lets units set scarcity prices; elastic priced imports soften off-peak). Unchanged by the gas-data fidelity fixes, which act on winter spike months only.

exceptions.metric: C3a system load-weighted mean LMP vs actual RT
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED (ledgered reserve-scarcity frontier + data-blocked eastern winter hub)
exceptions.reason: SOFT criterion -> CAVEAT. Improves from keeper-39's -19.2% purely from the corrected measured Dec-2024 hub level. The remaining December miss (-$25/MWh) is the DATA-BLOCKED eastern-NY (Iroquois Z2) winter hub level: the in-repo reconstruction (Transco monthly + SOM annual spread) reads ~$4.0/MMBtu for Dec-2024 while the New England complex the Z2 segment physically trades in cleared ~$9 (measured MA-citygate basis +6.12); no free Iroquois Z2 daily/monthly series exists (NGI/ICE paywalled; EIA NGWU carries no Iroquois row or narrative print 2023-2025 - verified by the fetch workflow). Kept per rule #13: the accurate data is not available, and no proxy construction is grounded enough to admit.

exceptions.metric: C5a annual system CO2 vs eGRID
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED (marginal breach exposed by a kept measured input; root cause = ledgered steam under-run)
exceptions.reason: SOFT criterion -> CAVEAT. The model's 2024 CO2 was already low at the band edge because the in-city steam/CHP fleet under-runs (ST_GAS -1.4 TWh, the ledgered reserve-scarcity/min-gen frontier; ~-0.6 Mt at the steam fleet rate covers most of the -2.1 Mt gap). Correcting the Dec-2024 hub level (rule #13: measured over estimate) shifted December burn off the dearer eastern units and moved the metric ~0.5pp across the band edge. Kept per rule #13 - the accurate input stays; the root cause is the same ledgered frontier, not the input.
